verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's public API documents a Create Campaign endpoint (klaviyo-docs-7), supported by private key/OAuth auth and SDKs, indicating campaigns can be created via API. However, there is no explicit documentation of an API endpoint or parameter for scheduling/sending the campaign (only creation is shown), so the full create-and-schedule workflow purely via API is not clearly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit send/schedule endpoint documentation, an end-to-end code example showing creation through scheduling without dashboard interaction, independent developer confirmation of the full flow.
